title: Unmake
goalLine: Turn each delivery into its two bits.

hints.text: Looking at each twin on its own gives nothing steady. Undo Alice's machine first.
Undo means the same steps in reverse order.
Run the linker, then the lens-changer, then look at each twin once.

events.no-visible-change: Nothing new came out of that step.

removePhysicsNote: Without the pair, one look at one parcel gives only one bit, so a second bit has nowhere to come from.
